verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP endpoint, a Claude connector, a Claude Code plugin, a CLI, an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt. None of it shows documented adapters for the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. A generic MCP endpoint or OpenAPI spec is only a building block a developer could wire up; it is not a framework adapter, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
